baselines.train_constant: mean of the train labels of the 28 d tier; computed on the common evaluation set at closure, no fit, no terminal

benchmark_contract.checkpoint_selection: best validation MAE, patience 3 epochs, restored

comparability.against: the block's own baseline under one declared estimand

reference_evidence.why: no reference run root was given

comparability.why: every identity field matches (contrast declared on ['split_rule']); the paper's metric is reported first

benchmark_contract.estimand: does a causal daily-lag channel y(t+h-1440) add predictive information to the W60 receiver, without paying for W1440 or changing receiver depth? (RP87; scoped as THIS feature addition, not an abstract information-only effect)
benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: mean over 10020 evaluation origins, one horizon
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE = mean |yhat - y| over the common evaluation set; MAE_z = MAE / sd_train
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: rows with a non-finite input withdrawn from the enumeration; nothing imputed
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence at the horizon, y(t), on identical origins
benchmark_contract.permitted_inputs: the 7 declared channels (6 features + the target's own history), window 60
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train windows (each row weighted by the windows containing it)
benchmark_contract.split_rule: DEV slice rows 1412361..1462761 (28 d train / 7 d validation) inside the family's train span; family test never read
benchmark_contract.target_construction: minute-averaged active power, kW, as published; not aggregated

daily_lag.how: a 4-channel calendar group adds one ARCH-A branch (detector + adapter) and 4 head/skip rows

capacity.initialization: every arm is built after set_random_seed(seed): arms of one seed are paired by seed, not weight-identical in their shared parts (a wider input changes the shapes and the draw order); the initial weights digest is recorded per cell

common_evaluation_rule: the intersection over the block's arms of admissible validation origins, with a finite label and a finite daily lookup, derived at prepare BEFORE any score; every arm scores on it

factorial.informed_by: prior DEV results (RP72, RP79); NOT confirmatory

inherited_control.capacity: 8 127 parameters, equal to modular_w60; the lag arm has 8 208 (+81: one more input column in the group-0 detector, one head row, one skip row; measured at seal)
inherited_control.declaration: the exact-crop control is the SAME computation as modular_w60 (the W1440 input cropped to its last 60 rows before the extractor: identical initial weights, identical tensors, identical training prefix — proved by tests/test_df_e1_block.py::test_RP87_the_exact_crop_control_is_training_equivalent...); it inherits the baseline's measurement and is NOT fitted again

lag_declaration.availability: at every decision t the row t-1380 is in the past by construction (h=60 <= 1440); the runner reads it from the padded panel rows and withdraws the origin when it is non-finite; no centered interpolation, no future fill
lag_declaration.channel: y(t + h - 1440) at origin t, i.e. the target's value at the panel row labelled 1440 minutes before the LABEL row t+h
lag_declaration.not_live_evidence: the archive declares no publication delay; UNKNOWN is not zero delay (stated)
lag_declaration.refers_to_timestamp: label(t) + h - 1440 minutes = label(t) - 1380 minutes: a row 23 hours BEFORE the decision

pilot.population: TRAIN_SUBSET: trains on train origins before the last 7 train days (purged W+h); validates on the last 7 train days; the DEV validation is never read by a pilot

pilots.population: TRAIN_SUBSET: trains on train origins before the last 7 train days (purged W+h); validates on the last 7 train days; the DEV validation is never read by a pilot
TRAIN_SUBSET: trains on train origins before the last 7 train days (purged W+h); validates on the last 7 train days; the DEV validation is never read by a pilot

question: does a causal daily-lag channel y(t+h-1440) add predictive information to the W60 receiver, without paying for W1440 or changing receiver depth? (RP87; scoped as THIS feature addition, not an abstract information-only effect)
reading_rules: three seeds on one task are development evidence
a fit that reached the update ceiling is CENSORED wherever its best checkpoint fell
no cell is removed after its score is seen
a published number under another protocol never enters the comparison column

recipe.monitor: validation MAE in scaled units (equals MAE_z with the common sigma)
recipe.role: HOUSEHOLD DEV SENSITIVITY TIER (RP79): the same cadence (every 200 observed updates), ceiling (4 000) and monitor; patience 10 events = 2 000 non-improving updates, approximately the former three passes (~1 881); no per-arm patience or budget tuning; no promise that longer patience improves error

rows.reading: the panel is read from lo (pad + the widest volume tier before the DEV train span) to hi; origins are enumerated inside [train span, validation week] from row identities; padded rows are support only

scaler_rule: COMMON: the source run's train-only scaler (28 d, W60 windows) for every arm and tier; calendar channels mean 0 / sd 1; the lag channel takes the target's scaler; one evaluation sigma = the target's train sd
tier: TIER2: RP79: patience 10 events (2 000 non-improving updates); informed by prior DEV behaviour
train_population_why: the lag withdraws the train origins whose lag row is non-finite; both arms train on the SAME origins
